tables.name: General Crime
tables.description: Modified by Leadership, Population Wealth and Law Enforcement. Dangerous, Frequent and Common (1-14) roll on Organized Crime. The baseline for every district's crime.

results.name: Dangerous
results.description: The streets are crawling with crime. Having things stolen is the least of folks’ worries. Vandalism and muggings are a daily occurrence, and discoveries of bodies are not what one would call ‘rare’. (Roll on organized crime table) (+5 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Frequent
results.description: The streets are unsafe, and a purse in plain sight is almost sure to be stolen. Vandalism and muggings are fairly regular. It’s dangerous to travel alone. (Roll on organized crime table) (+4 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Common
results.description: Most are used to hearing about some sort of trouble every day or two. Everyone knows someone who’s been a victim of crime, either a theft or, sometimes, even a mugging, or worse. (Roll on organized crime table) (+3 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Uncommon
results.description: Theft or mild violence happens from time to time. Best to keep an eye out, just in case. (+2 to urban encounter rolls)

results.name: Infrequent
results.description: Most don’t believe there is any crime, and certainly haven’t experienced any. (+1 to urban encounter rolls)
